summary: Specifies a YANG data model for client and server implementations of the Two-Way Active Measurement Protocol (TWAMP). The model is also described with UML class diagrams, and it lets network management tools configure and monitor TWAMP. It is standards-track.

eli5.summary: TWAMP is a way to measure how fast messages travel across a network. This document gives a standard form that management software can use to set up and read the measuring tools.
